app.name: AI Ticket Monitoring
app.short_description: Review AI ticket satisfaction and session details.
app.long_description: A read-only dashboard for completed AI support monitoring sessions. It shows ticket-level satisfaction, session-level score breakdowns, searchable records, and monitoring details saved by the support platform in Zendesk custom objects. Estimated satisfaction is not Zendesk's official CSAT.
app.installation_instructions: Install as a private Zendesk Support app. The app reads the ticket_csat_scores custom object using the signed-in agent's Zendesk permissions; no additional API key or database access is required.
